answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The jetty cap is checked at intake and trellis shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a zenith tag. That is 22 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
